description: This file defines the BoundedCachedCompressors struct and its methods for managing cached gzip and zlib compressors, including acquiring and releasing compressor resources.

classes.name: BoundedCachedCompressors
classes.description: A struct that manages a cache of gzip and zlib compressor resources with fixed capacity.

methods.name: NewBoundedCachedCompressors
methods.description: Constructor function that initializes a BoundedCachedCompressors instance with pre-filled caches.

methods.name: AcquireGzipWriter
methods.description: Returns a resettable *gzip.Writer, either from cache or a new unmanaged instance.

methods.name: ReleaseGzipWriter
methods.description: Releases a *gzip.Writer back into the cache if there is capacity.

methods.name: AcquireGzipReader
methods.description: Returns a *gzip.Reader, either from cache or a new unmanaged instance.

methods.name: ReleaseGzipReader
methods.description: Releases a *gzip.Reader back into the cache if there is capacity.

methods.name: AcquireZlibWriter
methods.description: Returns a *zlib.Writer, either from cache or a new unmanaged instance.

methods.name: ReleaseZlibWriter
methods.description: Releases a *zlib.Writer back into the cache if there is capacity.
